use: The Persian siege lines behind the battle: a line of siege screens beyond the board's north edge, in Chapter V.

generator.prompt: A line of eastern siege screens: four tall rectangular screens of woven reed and palm-rib mats on timber frames, each about one and a half metres wide and two point two metres high, standing side by side and propped from behind with slanting poles, with small loopholes for archers; about six metres long in all. Pale reed, palm ribs and weathered timber. Single isolated static prop for a grounded painterly-realistic historical game set in the third century Roman world. Physically based aged materials, believable hand-made construction and a bold, solid, readable silhouette from above, restrained surface detail, level base and complete geometry from every side. No environment, ground plane, decorative display plinth, modern materials, text, logos or people.
